description: This file defines the VirtualFileWrapper class, which implements the IAbstractFile interface to provide a wrapper around IntelliJ's VirtualFile, enabling content access, metadata retrieval, and folder navigation within the project.

classes.name: VirtualFileWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for VirtualFile providing content access, metadata, and folder navigation.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns an InputStream of the file's contents.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Retrieves the file content as a String within a read action.

methods.name: setContents
methods.description: Unsupported operation; intended to set file contents.

methods.name: getOutputStream
methods.description: Unsupported operation; intended to provide an output stream.

methods.name: getPreferredWriteMode
methods.description: Unsupported operation; indicates preferred write mode.

methods.name: getModificationStamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the file.

methods.name: getParentFolder
methods.description: Returns the parent folder as an IAbstractFolder, or null if none.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Unsupported operation; intended to delete the file.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on project and file.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on project and file.
